title: US man arrested for wiping phone during airport search; Android OS may trouble Europe travellers
description: A federal case in Atlanta questions privacy software use as criminal intent evidence. Prosecutors accuse Samuel Tunick of wiping his phone to prevent authorities from accessing its contents. GrapheneOS, a privacy-focused operating system, is central to the ongoing legal proceedings. Authorities in Europe also reportedly view GrapheneOS usage with suspicion. GrapheneOS developers state their software is legal and protects against unauthorized data extraction.

title: 6 orphaned rhinos rescued from poachers have all given birth in the wild
description: In a heartwarming turnaround, six orphaned rhinos from South Africa have welcomed new calves after years of rehabilitation. Their successful births signify a remarkable milestone in conservation efforts, providing renewed hope for endangered rhino populations. Wildlife officials emphasized that these births not only enrich the local ecosystem but also bolster South Africa's commitment to preserving this majestic species.

title: Scientists made seabirds fly harder. Only 67% returned next year
description: Researchers clipped a few wing and tail feathers of wild black-legged kittiwakes in Alaska to make flying more energy-intensive and tracked them for several years. The birds struggled to raise chicks during that breeding season, and fewer survived to return the next year. However, those that did return migrated farther and were more likely to breed successfully, showing how energy spent in one season can affect the next.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes' $1.625M gift creates new hope for Texas children
description: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes made a lasting impact off the football field with a $1.625 million partnership through the 15 and the Mahomies Foundation. Announced in October 2023, the initiative supports Boys & Girls Clubs in East Texas, Greater Kansas City and Lubbock, while also funding scholarships for hundreds of children and upgrading Club facilities. Here's how the Kansas City Chiefs star and his wife turned their hometown ties into a long-term commitment to help young people build brighter futures.
